_meta.description: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003 — Rules applicable to Commercial Buildings (Offices, Shops, Malls, Showrooms)

rules.title: Minimum Plot Area for Commercial
rules.error_message: Plot area {actual} sqm is below the minimum {expected} sqm required for commercial construction.
rules.recommendation: Commercial developments require a plot area of at least 100 sqm.
rules.explanation: Ensures adequate space for commercial activities, customer access, and parking.

rules.title: Minimum Road Width for Commercial Use
rules.error_message: Abutting road width {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m required for commercial development.
rules.recommendation: Commercial developments require an abutting road width of at least 12.0 m.
rules.explanation: Higher traffic generation from commercial establishments mandates wider public access roads.

rules.title: Maximum FAR for Commercial
rules.error_message: FAR {actual} exceeds the maximum permitted {expected} for commercial buildings.
rules.recommendation: Reduce total built-up area to maintain FAR ≤ 2.5.
rules.explanation: Controls commercial floor space density on urban plots.
